boundary_declarations.entry: **No validator and no fixture exists.** Every mechanical class above is a *definition* of what would be checkable; its per-contract execution is gated to a later authorised unit, and human review after any mechanical pass is always required. This contract declares no fixture identifier, no fixture format, and no catalogue identifier.

provenance_model: Dual provenance (PR-R1). Per contract: accepted_commit/accepted_content_hash identify the original acceptance event and the bytes accepted at it — immutable forever; a later erratum or amendment never changes them. governed_baseline_commit/governed_content_hash identify the published commit that most recently lawfully changed the contract's bytes and their hash — moved only by a governed validator-data update. Where no post-acceptance change exists the pairs are equal, and that equality is meaningful data. Runtime drift compares observed bytes against governed_content_hash (PR-R4).
